description: Put two or more things next to each other on the fields we can actually stand behind: price, what goes in and out, what it needs, how it is called, and what we measured. IMPORTANT: a field that is empty means we did not measure it. It does not mean zero and it does not mean bad. We do not publish numbers we did not take. Read-only. Fewer than two ids, or an id we do not have, comes back as an `error` field naming exactly what was wrong.

ids.description: The ids to compare, 2 to 6 of them.

name: compare_items
title: Compare things side by side
